messages:
maya: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
maya: did: kicked off canary fleet spin in eu-west-1 (8 GPUs) and wired autoscaler changes from last PR. verified routing policy to prefer low-latency zone.
maya: blocker: quota denied when trying to allocate A100s, got an InsufficientCapacity error when the launch attempted 8x A100 in a single AZ. logs below:
maya: ```
Error: InsufficientCapacity: Requested 8 x A100 not available in eu-west-1a
RequestId: c12f-xxxx-aaaa
```
omar: noted — timeline? can you retry with spread across two AZs or fall back to g5 instances? spreading should avoid single-AZ capacity spikes.
maya: can do spread, but that will change latency profile. prefer to keep eu-west-1 but spread across eu-west-1a/eu-west-1b. also opened quota request (see ticket) — need quota approved for A100s to keep this stable.
sasha: I filed the quota uplift with cloud support: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2345 — added the weekly justification and perf numbers. support asked for expected sustained vCPU/GPU hours, added our 30-day forecast.
jinx-bot: autoscaler: configuration update applied by maya: {"min_nodes":2,"max_nodes":12,"scale_down_delay":180} at 1774448123
omar: re: mitigation — short term we can set autoscaler max_nodes to 10 and enable instance-type-fallback to g5. also recommend lowering `scale_down_delay` to 120s for canary queues to reduce churn.
maya: putting the temp config here to test (will revert after smoke):
maya: ```
autoscaler:
  min_nodes: 2
  max_nodes: 10
  instance_fallback: [A100,g5]
  scale_down_delay: 120
```
sasha: I'll pick up the CR to make the config change and run the smoke tests once quota is confirmed. ping me when cloud support marks the ticket `approved`.
maya: today: will run the spread-launch test (eu-west-1a/b), collect perf/latency numbers, and post results. if quota approved, I'll re-run full canary.
omar: I'll also add an alert for InsufficientCapacity spikes so oncall gets immediate context. small ask: tag the canary with `canary=eu-west-spread` so our dashboards filter it.
maya: will add tag. thanks. :thumbsup:
sasha: quick Q — do we want to opt into Dedicated fallback for heavy jobs while cloud quota is pending? could avoid user impact.
omar: yes let's keep Dedicated as fallback for critical routes. I'll update routing policy to prefer Dedicated when A100 capacity < 50% for the region.
maya: ok, will update the runbook steps and note the fallback. will post results by EOD.
